level1317-毁灭辣椒:
The Glove has no CD in this level.
M.A.D. Pepper also destroys plants to trigger Doom explosions at their positions with a chance to return seed packets.
Stacked Puff-shrooms can only trigger one explosion,
but the seed packet(s) dropped by any one of them can be used 3 times, so spread them out!
Only M.A.D. Pepper itself's explosion leaves a crater, so think about where you place them!
After reading the tip, click on the M.A.D. Pepper in the middle of the screen!
level1318-豌豆南瓜:

Different Pea families should be paired with different Torchwoods!

level1319-火辣豌豆射手:

Blaze peas inflict Enflamed debuff

level1323-大蒜南瓜:
